description: Permissions shared by the settings window and the correction overlay. Note that `opener:allow-open-url` only enables the command and grants no URL scope — without `opener:allow-default-urls` every link is refused by the scope check and silently does nothing. Both are required. Deliberately not `opener:default`, which also grants reveal-item-in-dir that this app never uses. The window permissions are what a frameless window needs to be dragged, resized and controlled from its custom titlebar.
